The bug causing `NullPointerException` during data range calculations on an [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4493) when a renderer is `null` has been resolved.

### Cause of the Bug
In [`XYPlot.getDataRange(ValueAxis axis)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4425), after computing bounds with `if (r != null) ... else ...`, `r.getAnnotations()` was invoked without checking whether `r` was non-null. When a dataset was assigned to the plot without a renderer (or renderer was explicitly `null`), `r.getAnnotations()` resulted in a `NullPointerException`.

### Fix
Added a null-check `if (r != null)` before accessing annotations on `r` in [`XYPlot.getDataRange`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4493).
